steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing the unit.

steps.title: Outlet and cord
steps.body: Verify 120 VAC at outlet and power cord to MAIN PWB.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify 120 VAC at outlet and power cord to MAIN PWB.

steps.title: MAIN PWB supply
steps.body: Check MAIN PWB power input and noise filter path.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check MAIN PWB power input and noise filter path.

steps.title: Replace MAIN PWB
steps.oemOutcome: Replace MAIN PWB when supply verified but control dead.

steps.title: Power path OK
steps.oemOutcome: Supply and MAIN PWB input verified.
